title: quantile throws error if not convertible to float
body:
If we try and `quantile` a DataFrame with string entries which are not convertible, there is a ValueError. Should this behave like mean (and ignore these entries)? (taken from [this StackOverflow question](http://stackoverflow.com/questions/14125428/how-to-apply-quantile-to-pandas-groupby-object)).

```

In [2]: df
Out[2]:
  col1  col2
0    A     1
1    A     2
2    B     3
3    B     4


In [3]: g = df.groupby('col1')

In [4]: g.mean()

col1      
A      1.5
B      3.5
```
